assumptions.units: Model values: P8 degC, T11 t/h, F19 MPa; no conversion of production CSV asserted
assumptions.avt: Fixed illustrative diesel mass yield 0.2 and sulfur partition 0.5; not fitted to plant
assumptions.ht: Sout=Sin*exp(-(5.8+0.06*(T-340)+0.35*(P-4))*100/Q); monotone illustrative kinetics, not measured effect
assumptions.response: Effective controls=current+alpha*(command-current); alpha=clamp((horizon-delay)/0.5,0,1). All controls have the same illustrative response. Feed properties are already effective for the evaluated batch. No AVT transport lag estimated
assumptions.mixing: Mass fractions on final product: fresh HT + clean tank + heavy tank + additive = 1. S mass balance; T95 and CN linear surrogates, not validated mixing laws. Additive assigned zero S and no change to base T95; CN uplift=400*final mass fraction
assumptions.cost: Diesel base cost=1 per tonne; HT cost=1+0.0002*(T-330)^2+0.04*(P-3)^2+0.08*(100/Q-1); clean=1.6, heavy=0.85, additive=100. Only cost of streams used in target batch; unused HT output goes to unmodeled storage
assumptions.equipment: severity=0.6*(T-330)/40+0.4*(P-3)/2; limit 0.85. This is a model burden index, not failure probability
assumptions.limits: All numeric control bounds, tank properties/capacities, quality margins and baseline are invented for this model; expert named roles only
assumptions.freshness: Scenario inputs are manual synthetic values; no real LIMS/PAC ingestion. Separate contract checks demonstrate LIMS upper-bound eligibility
assumptions.optimizer: Finite grid plus current candidate; minimum cost per tonne, ties closest to current then deterministic order; global optimum not claimed
